privileged_info_for_vlm: The meeting room must be 'MathTutoringSession'. The display name must be 'Tutor Alex'. The target setting is located in the 'Video' tab of the Settings menu. The UI label for mirroring may appear as 'Mirror local video', 'Mirror my video', or 'Mirror self view'. The task is only complete if the mirroring checkbox is UNCHECKED and the settings menu is still visible in the final frame.
